citation_details.title: STRONG
citation_details.author: Tony Johnson, Stephen Gordon, Jon Touryan, Kevin King
citation_details.abstract: STRONG is an EEG dataset derived from OpenNeuro dataset ds004849 (v1.0.0). This dataset contains raw EEG recordings and associated metadata in BIDS format. The dataset includes EEG data files (.set, .fdt), event information (.tsv), and JSON sidecars for complete documentation of acquisition parameters. Data are provided in EEGLAB format with BIDS-compliant JSON sidecars and TSV event files for full reproducibility. [NOTE: This description requires substantiation by completing the README with actual dataset details including research objectives, participant demographics, experimental tasks, acquisition parameters, and preprocessing methods before DOI minting.]
